partido: Glasner vuelve a Selhurst: Palace 3-1 Forest
text:
Oliver Glasner won Crystal Palace the FA Cup. On Sunday, back at Selhurst Park with Nottingham Forest, his old side came from behind to beat him 3–1 and the home fans taunted him. Taunting the man who won you a trophy: fair? 👇
